### 1 Bedroom Houseboat in Alleppey
- URL: https://alleppeybooking.com/1-bedroom-houseboat-alleppey/
- Category: Private Kerala Backwater Houseboat
- Number of Bedrooms: 1
- Attached Bathrooms: 1 (Private Western Style with Hot/Cold Water)
- Capacity: 2 Adults (Up to 4 with extra beds)
- Starting Price: ₹11,000
- Highlight Badge: Most Popular for Couples
- Overview: Experience the ultimate private romantic getaway on our private 1 bedroom houseboat in Alleppey. Featuring a cozy air-conditioned bedroom with attached bathroom, scenic front living deck, and dedicated crew members including an expert captain and personal chef.

  #### Available Tiers & Pricing:
  - **Deluxe Tier**: ₹11,000 / night
    * AC Policy: Night AC (9 PM - 6 AM)
    * Meals: All 3 Meals + Tea
    * Deck / Lounge: Front Glass Deck
  - **Premium Tier**: ₹11,000 / night
    * AC Policy: Full-Time 24h AC
    * Meals: Deluxe Menu + Kerala Fish Fry
    * Deck / Lounge: Upper Sun Deck
  - **Luxury Tier**: ₹13,500 / night
    * AC Policy: Full-Time 24h AC
    * Meals: Chef Special + Karimeen Pollichathu
    * Deck / Lounge: Private Upper Lounge

  #### Amenities & Inclusions:
  - Air Conditioning (9:00 PM TO 6:00 AM)
  - Private Crew (Captain, Cook, Engine Driver)
  - 1 Bedroom + Attached Bathroom (Clean & well-maintained)
  - 100% Private (The whole boat is yours)
  - Backwater Cruise (5 to 6 hours of sightseeing)
  - Drinks & Snacks (Welcome drink & evening tea)
  - All Inclusive (Taxes & fuel charges covered)

  #### Frequently Asked Questions:
  - Q: Is the 1 bedroom houseboat safe for children and infants?
    A: Yes, our houseboats are fully enclosed with safety rails. Please note that our crew is not specially trained for elderly assistance, and life jackets are not provided for houseboats, so please plan accordingly.
  - Q: Can we get pure vegetarian food?
    A: Yes, we prepare excellent pure vegetarian meals in a separate, clean kitchen area. Just let us know your dietary preferences when confirming your booking.
  - Q: Are portable speakers allowed on board?
    A: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own portable speakers. However, out of respect for the local village communities, we kindly request low volume after 10:00 PM.

    A: Yes, both bedrooms are situated side-by-side along the corridor of the houseboat, making it highly convenient for parents traveling with children in the adjacent room.
  - Q: Do both bedrooms have their own private bathrooms?
    A: Absolutely. Each of the two air-conditioned bedrooms comes with its own fully equipped, attached western-style washroom for complete privacy between groups.
  - Q: Is the houseboat safe for toddlers and elderly family members?
    A: Our family houseboats are fully enclosed with sturdy safety rails. However, please note that the crew is not medically trained for elderly care, and guests must supervise toddlers closely while on the open deck.

3. OPERATIONAL STANDARDS & CRUISE PROTOCOLS
================================================================================
- Check-in: 12:00 PM (Noon) at Finishing Point Jetty, Alleppey.
- Check-out: 9:00 AM following morning.
- Cruise Route: Punnamada Lake, Nehru Trophy starting point, SNDP canal, Kuppappuram, Meenappally, Kainakary, and Vembanad Lake.
- Safety: Government licensed vessels, life buoys, life jackets for all passengers, fire-safety certified, experienced local navigators.
- Booking Process: Direct reservation with instant WhatsApp confirmation via +91 70127 61588.
